debug.description: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting.

items.description: Full path to a web server access log to analyze.

log_files.description: List of paths to web server log files (e.g., Apache, Nginx) to process.

url.description: Base URL of your web property (used to build absolute links in reports).

output_dir.description: Directory where generated HTML reports and related files will be written.

use_gzip.description: Compress output files (e.g., gzipped HTML) to save space.

timezone.description: Timezone offset in hours relative to UTC (e.g., -5 for EST).

date_format.description: Date format used in report filenames and headers (strftime syntax).

retention.description: Number of days of log data to retain in reports. Set to 0 for unlimited.

items.description: IP address to exclude from analysis (e.g., internal crawler or test IPs).

ignore_ips.description: List of IP addresses to ignore during log processing.

items.description: URL pattern to exclude (supports wildcards like *.png).

exclude_patterns.description: Patterns for URLs to exclude from reports (e.g., static assets).

items.description: URL pattern to include (only matches are analyzed, overriding excludes).

include_patterns.description: If non-empty, only URLs matching these patterns will be included in reports.

users_enabled.description: Track per-user activity (requires log format includes user field, e.g., basic auth).

referrer_enabled.description: Analyze and report referrer URLs (e.g., which sites link to yours).

keywords_enabled.description: Extract and report search engine keywords used to find your site.

browser_enabled.description: Detect and report browser and operating system usage.

country_enabled.description: Geolocate visitors by country (requires GeoIP database).

geoip_db_path.description: Path to the MaxMind GeoIP database (only required if country analysis is enabled).

top_count.description: Number of top items (pages, referrers, keywords, countries) to display.

hide_short_urls.description: Hide URLs shorter than this length in reports (e.g., to hide /robots.txt).

hourly_24h.description: Use 24-hour time in hourly reports (e.g., 23:00 instead of 11:00 PM).

items.description: HTTP status code to skip (e.g., '304' for 'Not Modified').

skip_status_list.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP status codes to ignore in analysis.

log_format.description: Log format specification matching your web server logs (Apache/Nginx combined format by default).

report_title.description: Title used in HTML report headers and pages.

feed_enabled.description: Generate RSS/Atom feeds summarizing key metrics.

summary_enabled.description: Generate a top-level index.html with links to all reports.

secure_enabled.description: Use HTTPS for all links in generated reports (set if your site is HTTPS).

custom_css.description: Optional path to a custom CSS file to style HTML reports.

report_max_age.description: Maximum age (in days) of log data included in daily/weekly/monthly reports.

cache_enabled.description: Enable caching to speed up repeated analyses (useful for frequent runs).

cache_dir.description: Directory for caching parsed log data (only used if caching is enabled).
